rationale: wu_2015-claude-agentic: wu_n_bands=12, wu_n_outer=1, wu_motion_range=8, wu_motion_window=2, wu_soft_thresh=0.0007, val_n=200, val_chunk=4, seed=42, rationale=ITER-10 (one knob vs iter-9 best). NUMBERS n_bands sweep at n_outer=1: 6->RMSE0.005542, 8->RMSE0.005260(iter-9, PSNR36.25) -- finer partition MONOTONE improves step-1, gap to the 0.005214 baseline shrank from 6.3pct to 0.9pct. n_bands is THE productive lever here. FAILURE MODE: step-1 aliasing-free FBP fidelity is band-resolution-limited; more bands = finer per-radius sigmoid control = closer to the true aliasing-free image = smaller residual correction needed. ONE KNOB: wu_n_bands 8 -> 12 (n_outer/thresh/motion locked). HYPOTHESIS: if the monotone n_bands trend continues, 12 bands push RMSE below the 0.005214 baseline and hr>0 CLEARS baseline for the first time this campaign; if RMSE plateaus/rises (bands so narrow they under-sample the ramp and add high-freq noise), the optimum brackets in (8,12) and I bisect. Budget: 12 bands ~ 2x iter-9 back-projection, still seconds, <20min.
